function.name: execute_bash

content:
cc -c -g -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer -g -DLZ4_DEBUG=1   -I../lib -DXXH_NAMESPACE=LZ4_ compress_fuzzer.c -o compress_fuzzer.o
# Compile the standalone code just in case. The OSS-Fuzz code might
# override the LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE value to "-fsanitize=fuzzer"
cc -c -g -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer -g -DLZ4_DEBUG=1   -I../lib -DXXH_NAMESPACE=LZ4_ standaloneengine.c -o standaloneengine.o
# Now compile the actual fuzzer.
g++ -g -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer -g -DLZ4_DEBUG=1   -I../lib -DXXH_NAMESPACE=LZ4_  standaloneengine.o compress_fuzzer.o ../lib/liblz4.a -o compress_fuzzer
rm compress_fuzzer.o
